contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver. Coin. Commemorative Denarius of Faustina (138-161), posthumous issue of 141, RIC volume 3 no. 362. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: DIVA [F]AVSTINA. Reverse description: Female figure, probably Ceres, draped standing left with long ?torch and lifting skirt. Reverse inscription: AVG[V]STA. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.70gms, die axis: 12
